scope: Three common dynamic-data conditions: H1/F0, H10/F0, H10/F10. Same incoming actors, zero-output adapter head, frozen normalization, rounds and supervised updates. Adapter input dimensions and parameter counts differ; no isolated parameter-capacity or matched-time claim. Past observations are causal; future targets are known procedural commands at +1..+10 control steps. No future physical states, critic training or world-model fitting.
